title: Student Assistant for driving the IT/Digital PMO team with PMO Cluster Lead and Management team
description_md:
Are you ready to “forward your career” in the world’s largest logistics company?

This role will serve as the right hand of the IT/Digital Cluster Lead making sure that the Project Managers and Agile Coaches have what they need to lead initiatives on behalf of our stakeholders.

We expect you to work 20 hours per week, preferably spread across two or three full days in the office.
